subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should maintainers keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41265 as the canonical fix after narrowing and refreshing it, or replace it with a fresh current-main branch?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the active PR has proof and media-contract questions that automation should not settle while this issue remains paired with that PR.

options.title: Refresh and narrow the linked PR
options.body: Keep the contributor PR as canonical, update it to current main, remove or explicitly approve broader media/SDK behavior, and require live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Replace with a narrow branch
options.body: Open a fresh branch that credits the source work and fixes only the current Discord/media paths needed for this issue.

options.title: Approve the broader media contract
options.body: Accept the user-visible preserved-media behavior deliberately, but require documentation, tests, and proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Refresh and narrow the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep the contributor PR as canonical, update it to current main, remove or explicitly approve broader media/SDK behavior, and require live Discord proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across Discord send helpers, shared media loading, and plugin/API boundary work involved in this choice.
